subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add a public Telegram TTS delivery policy for full-width text plus a separate voice note, and should that policy live in global `messages.tts` or Telegram channel/account config?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix adds public config/channel behavior and overlaps with captioned-final, voice-only, and cross-channel TTS text-delivery policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow separate mode
options.body: Keep captioned voice as the default, add an explicit separate mode in the chosen config scope, and require schema/docs/tests/live Telegram proof across both modes.

options.title: Keep captioned delivery standard
options.body: Document tagged/manual splitting and overflow fallback as the supported workaround instead of adding another TTS delivery mode now.

options.title: Defer until captioned-final settles
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83988 or its replacement before deciding whether separate delivery should become first-class.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow separate mode
recommendation.body: Keep captioned voice as the default, add an explicit separate mode in the chosen config scope, and require schema/docs/tests/live Telegram proof across both modes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across core TTS, config policy, and Telegram caption behavior touched by this product decision.
